## Segment summary
A person interacts with a small, cube-shaped robot named "StackChan" on a desk. The robot's screen displays a simple face and responds to touch and voice input. The user also configures the robot's settings via a smartphone app, selecting an AI model and viewing its access point details. The segment concludes with the user viewing a live camera feed from the robot on their phone.

## Segment summary
A person uses a smartphone app to configure a small, cube-shaped robot named StackChan, selecting its voice and motion settings. The user then interacts with the physical robot, adjusting its head position and triggering it to display various facial expressions and speak. The robot performs a simple task—searching for music—and displays the results before returning to a neutral expression.
